function.arguments: {"finding": "The treatment was not randomised, and clinicians assigned treatment preferentially to sicker patients. The distribution of baseline severity differs between arms: treatment arm has more severe and moderate cases, while control has more mild cases. This creates a confounding factor — severity is associated with both treatment assignment and response rate — so comparing raw response rates between arms gives a biased estimate of treatment effect.", "implication": "The raw difference in proportions between arms is not a valid estimate of the treatment effect. We must adjust for severity (e.g., stratify, standardise, or model it) to isolate the true treatment effect. Reporting the raw difference would be misleading and possibly wrong in sign."}
function.name: note_finding
